rule: ENTER BETA only if every entry criterion is met. Failing quality or budget gates do NOT block Beta (they become the measured deficits that drive Beta issues); missing evidence, unpromoted architecture, or unmeasured populations DO block it, because architecture/product viability is then unproven.

criteria.title: Architecture selected by the promotion rule
Selection recorded as a fastner ADR (promotion_state = promoted)
Selected candidate pin fully resolved (runtime commit, model digest, adapter)
Pinned ner-evidence snapshot measured for the selected candidate
Every size/performance budget gate has a measurement
Each profile language has a pinned reference that is measured, or explicitly unavailable with a reason
Support gate thresholds ratified against a real baseline

beta_suggestion_templates.title: Reduce false positives on ambiguous names
Raise English entity F1 on the public snapshot
Raise Korean entity F1 on the public snapshot
Fix English tokenization/boundary failures from the regression corpus
Fix Korean tokenization and particle failures from the regression corpus
Reduce English false positives under adversarial input
Reduce Korean particle false positives under adversarial input
